entries.text: Fresh stack space (premise F): when esp is loaded from a register that is not a known stack address (chkstk/alloca: esp = esp - size), the fresh space is disjoint from every tracked slot of the old frame: its accesses are below the new esp or inside the allocated block, and the new esp does not lie above a live tracked old slot (size >= 0, no wraparound, no access past the allocated size). A red-free pcsrc result of an entry that creates a fresh space holds under it (cond:fresh, listed as cond_fresh_list in gate_pcsrc.json).
